request.initial_prompt: "The Emperor! The Emperor! The Marshal! The Duke!" and hardly had the sleek cavalry passed, before a carriage drawn by six gray horses rattled by. Pierre caught a glimpse of a man in a three-cornered hat with a tranquil look on his handsome, plump, white face. It was one of the marshals. His eye fell on Pierre's large and striking figure, and in the expression with which he frowned and looked away Pierre thought he detected sympathy and a desire to conceal that sympathy.

raw_segments.text: The Emperor! The Emperor! The Marshal! The Duke! and hardly had the sleek cavalry passed,
before a carriage drawn by six gray horses rattled by. Pierre caught a glimpse of a man
in a three-cornered hat with a tranquil look on his handsome, plump, white face.
It was one of the marshals. His eye fell on Pierre's large and striking figure,
and in the expression with which he frowned and looked away Pierre thought he detected
sympathy and a desire to conceal that sympathy.
